productionPlan.poseBrief: Standing full length in calm three-quarter front view, weight on right leg, arms relaxed at his sides, chin slightly turned toward the river.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Une jetée fluviale contemporaine, barrières acier et tours de Gotham au crépuscule bleu.

productionPlan.poseBrief: One small flat Nolan-style folding batarang alone, opened symmetrically and resting diagonally on a dark workshop block. No person, no hand.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Table d’atelier Wayne en acier sombre, lumière latérale chaude et outils flous en arrière-plan.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Empty environment with a low open foreground and deep perspective along the ferry quay; absolutely no characters or silhouettes.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Quai de ferry nocturne à Gotham, guérite vide, barrières et skyline de gratte-ciel réalistes au loin.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Standing sideways with his torso bent slightly toward a compact grapnel device held in both hands at waist level, carefully inspecting its line spool.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Garage technique souterrain contemporain, établi de maintenance et béton clair sous tubes fluorescents.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Midair horizontal swing on one taut grapnel cable, right arm extended upward holding the compact grapnel, left arm tucked near chest, one knee bent and cape streaming behind.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Passerelle de verre brisée dans une gare Nexus, faille cyan en contrebas et balises orange.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Stepping forward through a tall doorway, left boot passing the threshold, left hand pushing the door, right hand low beside the belt; front view, calm alert expression.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Station de maintenance ferroviaire désaffectée, porte acier entrouverte, carrelage ancien et lampes industrielles.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Standing straight at a rooftop edge seen from low three-quarter rear angle, hands relaxed behind his back, head turned toward the rising sun, cape hanging still.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Toit plat au lever du soleil, ventilation métallique et skyline baignée d’or rose.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Sitting exhausted on a stone bench, elbows on knees, gloved hands loosely clasped, head lowered; intact suit, alive, no blood or wounds.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Passage piéton couvert sous une ligne aérienne, banc de pierre et pluie ruisselant derrière les colonnes.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Sitting sideways on a weathered driftwood log in full armor and cowl, legs relaxed forward, examining one shell in his right gloved hand, left hand resting on the log.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Petite plage rocheuse familiale à marée basse, cabanes de bain bleues et ciel d’été pâle.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Walking with one cautious step while carrying a tray with two mugs of cocoa in both gloved hands at chest height, looking down to keep it level.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Salle communautaire de Gotham décorée sobrement pour l’hiver, table nappée et guirlandes de papier.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Twisting his torso halfway backward with one hand reaching behind to unhook the hem of his cape from a low waist-high turnstile; one foot lifted slightly, harmless awkward pause.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Entrée de musée municipal fermée au public, portillon bas en laiton et panneaux sans texte lisible.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Standing in stern three-quarter rear view beside a surveillance console, one gloved palm resting on the console, head turned back toward viewer, shoulders rigid.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Salle de commande de sécurité autoritaire, grandes vitres et écrans abstraits sans texte.

productionPlan.poseBrief: A fictional adult female counterpart in the same modest functional segmented Batsuit and cowl, walking in full side profile with head turned forward and one hand lightly lifting the cape to clear a shallow puddle.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Cour intérieure d’un palais de justice moderne, dalles blanches, bassin rectangulaire et pluie fine.

productionPlan.poseBrief: Leaning against a concrete pillar with one forearm braced on it above shoulder height, head bowed sideways, other arm hanging; original body intact with only subtle pale exposed jaw and muted cold eyes.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Ancienne aile de centrale électrique mise en quarantaine, fenêtres hautes vertes et poussière en suspension.

productionPlan.poseBrief: An older version of the same masked man walking slowly in strict side profile, right foot lifting off the wet paving, one gloved hand at his belt and the other easing his cape away from the ground.
productionPlan.backgroundBrief: Terrasse de pierre d’un observatoire urbain, pluie arrêtée et éclaircie tardive sur les collines de Gotham.

limitations: La série personnage demeure bloquée par ImageGen : erreurs moderation_blocked/output/other ; aucune répétition visant à contourner le filtre.
CG02 reste à comparer visuellement à une image du vrai accessoire.
Aucun personnage de remplacement générique et aucune fausse image de CG01 enregistrés.
